newsitem.title: USA: WPS Resources Q2 hurt by electric margins.
newsitem.headline: WPS Resources Q2 hurt by electric margins.

text.p: WPS Resources Corp said Wednesday lower electric profit margins trimmed its earnings by $0.11 a share.

Lower electric margins resulted from a rate decrease and higher replacement power costs due to an extended outage at Kewaunee Nuclear Power Plant. WPS is the operator and 41.2 percent owner of Kewaunee.
Kewaunee returned to service in mid-June.
Earler, WPS reported second quarter earnings of $0.40 a share, down from $0.42.

Increased depreciation and decommissioning expenses cut second quarter earnings by $0.09 a share. WPS said these expenses increased due to the accelerated recovery of the utility's investment in Kewaunee and accelerated funding of Kewaunee decommissioning costs.
